`getReassignmentConfigTypesV1` — List reassignment config types — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

- Returns 200: array of configurationresponse

### POST /reassignment-configurations/v1

`createReassignmentConfigurationV1` — Create a reassignment configuration — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

- User levels: ORG_ADMIN

`getReassignmentConfigurationV1` — Get reassignment configuration — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

  - `identityId` (path, required) — unique identity id

### PUT /reassignment-configurations/v1/{identityId}

`putReassignmentConfigV1` — Update reassignment configuration — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Replaces existing Reassignment configuration for an identity with the newly provided configuration.

### DELETE /reassignment-configurations/v1/{identityId}/{configType}

`deleteReassignmentConfigurationV1` — Delete reassignment configuration — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Deletes a single reassignment configuration for the specified identity

- Scopes: idn:reassignment-configuration:manage
- Parameters:
  - `identityId` (path, required) — unique identity id
  - `configType` (path, required) — one of ACCESS_REQUESTS, CERTIFICATIONS, MANUAL_TASKS, GENERIC_APPROVALS
- Returns 204: no body

### GET /reassignment-configurations/v1/{identityId}/evaluate/{configType}

`getEvaluateReassignmentConfigurationV1` — Evaluate reassignment configuration — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Evaluates the Reassignment Configuration for an `Identity` to determine if work items for the specified type should be reassigned. If a valid Reassignment Configuration is found for the identity & work type, then a lookup is initiated which recursively fetches the Reassignment Configuration for the next `TargetIdentity` until no more results are found or a max depth of 5. That lookup trail is provided in the response and the final reassigned identity in the lookup list is returned as the…

- Scopes: idn:reassignment-configuration:manage
- Parameters:
  - `identityId` (path, required) — unique identity id
  - `configType` (path, required) — one of ACCESS_REQUESTS, CERTIFICATIONS, MANUAL_TASKS, GENERIC_APPROVALS — Reassignment work type
  - `exclusionFilters` (query) — Exclusion filters that disable parts of the reassignment evaluation. Possible values are listed below: - `SELF_REVIEW_DELEGATION`: This will exclude delegations of self-review reassignments
- Returns 200: array of evaluateresponse
